items.reason: Gap 0 describes two concurrent deliveries of the same event both finding the id missing and both running the handler.
Gap 1 says the key comes from the unsigned X-Event-Id header so the same signed body can be processed under many ids.
Gap 2 says the provider sends charge.refunded while only refund.created is registered, so refunds are dropped.
No gap depends on several processes, instances, or replicas.
